items.title: Bind delivery-check artifacts to reviewed material
items.context: delivery_check_set records the current materialHash/headHash in delivery-check.json and includes the material binding in the integrity hash; missing or tampered bindings fail closed instead of silently passing.
items.userSees: delivery-check evidence contains the material binding it reviewed.
excludes: Do not change delivery reviewer role ownership or allow the main agent to self-sign delivery-check evidence.
Do not treat local evidence as Authority or production proof.

happy.desc: A fresh delivery-check written over the current material remains accepted by DONE readiness.

edge.desc: A metadata-only head change with unchanged material does not force a delivery reviewer rerun.

adversarial.desc: A delivery-check with missing or tampered material binding is rejected as stale/tampered, not accepted as delivery_check_passed.

items.title: Fail closed when material changes after delivery-check
items.context: DONE oracle, machine guard, and lifecycle readiness classify material drift after delivery-check as stale_delivery_check and block DONE until lattice-review-delivery reruns.
items.userSees: DONE pre-check shows stale delivery-check instead of PASS when source material changed after delivery review.
excludes: Do not weaken validation, review, summary, or done_prepare gates.
Do not add a dashboard or external server dependency.

happy.desc: After source material changes, DONE readiness reports stale delivery-check and blocks DONE.

edge.desc: Existing docsPromise validation semantics still fail unverified promises independently of material freshness.

adversarial.desc: Changing delivery-check binding fields without resigning produces a hash/tamper failure.

items.title: Add focused regression smoke and baseline result artifact
items.context: Add a focused smoke for delivery-check freshness and a derived baseline item 5 result JSON without modifying the immutable baseline v1 file.
items.userSees: A focused validate command proves baseline item 5 is fixed and documents the before/after result.
excludes: Do not edit the immutable baseline v1 artifact.
Do not broaden this into DONE summary freshness; that remains baseline item 6.

happy.desc: Focused smoke passes and is wired into validate.commands with fast focus.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline v1 file remains unchanged; only a story-specific result artifact is added.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact explicitly states authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.
